what: count, not a board measurement, and NOT pre-registered: layouts L0-L3 (PROTOCOL_2.md) on the CIFAR-10 classifier of cifar/ (train_cifar.py, quantize_cifar.py), per-window predict_w4.window_cycles, sparse mode, conv1..conv6, fill and drain left out

network.integer_accuracy_note: scripts/run_cifar.py emulation path (classify), on the images below

provenance.note: made in a scratch directory for this count; the checkpoint and export are not in the repository

data.source: Hugging Face dataset uoft-cs/cifar10, plain_text parquet (PNG bytes), converted to uint8 arrays; no pickle from the download was loaded for training

official_test_set_check.what: the npz test images and labels are identical, image by image and in order, to the official CIFAR-10 test_batch (www.cs.toronto.edu/~kriz/cifar-10-python.tar.gz)
official_test_set_check.also: --data with run_cifar.load_cifar_test on the official test_batch gives the same fits, classes and per-image totals on the first 200 images

training.script: cifar/train_cifar.py main(), unchanged, run through a wrapper that replaces torchvision.datasets.CIFAR10 by the same images from npz and computes Net in channels_last
training.args: --epochs 15 --workers 1 (defaults otherwise: batch 128, SGD lr 0.1 momentum 0.9 nesterov, weight decay 5e-4, OneCycleLR, RandomCrop 32 pad 4 + horizontal flip); CPU only
training.epochs_note: 15 epochs instead of the script default 60, to fit the time box
training.model_selection: train_cifar.py keeps the epoch with the best TEST accuracy (here the last, 15)

quantization.script: cifar/quantize_cifar.py main(), unchanged, same wrapper, defaults (--calib 512: activation ranges from the first 512 TEST images, as the script does)

source.kind: npz of the CIFAR-10 test set, images uint8 (N, 3, 32, 32) / 255 as run_cifar.load_cifar_test

images.headline: the 9999 test images other than the calibration image

layouts.L2: skew_count.skew_order: slot s*C + (p + s) % C, bank (s + p) % 4
layouts.L3: fit.fit_general under the skewed rule (evaluate_2.skew_residue_counts), then evaluate_2.skew_columns

recipe.windows_per_layer: min(2048, windows of the calibration image)
recipe.search: fit.fit_general: identity start, 400 proposals, seed 42 + fitted-layer index

adaptations: network and images: the CIFAR-10 classifier and the CIFAR-10 test set, not the denoisers on Set12/BSD68; calibration image = test image 0 (in place of Set12 01.png)

fitted layers conv2..conv6 (every layer reading a hidden map), conv6 included because its COUT is 128 (the protocols left out the denoisers' COUT <= 4 output layer); conv6_left_at_L0 gives the strict reading
calibration sample = every window of the 32x32 calibration image (1024/256/256/64/64 < 2048)
counting run: accumulators as an exact float64 product, checked against run_cifar.oracle on the first 100 images and on the function-check image

function_check.oracle: scripts/run_cifar.oracle on every window of every layer

checks.note: asserted while counting: float64 accumulators == run_cifar.oracle and the W=4 count == the fits' fast objective on the checked images; perfect balance <= every layout on every image and layer

bootstrap.generator: np.random.default_rng(0).integers(0, 9999, (1000, 9999)) x 10, paired over layouts and widths

saving: 100 * (L0 - layout) / L0, pooled = on the summed counts of the headline images

per_image_totals.order: per_image_totals[wN][column][image], column in ['L0', 'L1', 'L2', 'L3', 'perfect_balance'], image = test index
